name: Interest Rate Hikes
description: News related to central banks increasing benchmark interest rates, directly impacting the cost of debt capital.

name: Interest Rate Cuts
description: News related to central banks decreasing benchmark interest rates, making debt capital cheaper.

name: Venture Capital Funding Rounds (Equity)
description: Announcements of significant equity funding rounds for venture-backed companies, which often influence their need and ability to raise debt.

name: Venture Debt Deal Announcements
description: Specific news about venture debt facilities being closed, including deal size, terms, and the participating companies and lenders.

name: Venture Debt Lender Activity
description: News concerning the strategies, expansion, or contraction of venture debt providers, including new funds raised by lenders.

name: Startup Valuations
description: Reports and analyses on the changing valuations of startups, which can affect their borrowing capacity and the attractiveness of venture debt.

name: Economic Growth Forecasts
description: Projections for overall economic expansion or contraction, influencing investor sentiment and the risk appetite for debt financing.

name: Inflation Trends
description: News regarding the rate of inflation, which can prompt changes in monetary policy and affect the real cost of debt.

name: Sector-Specific Boom/Bust Cycles
description: News highlighting rapid growth or decline in specific technology or venture-backed sectors that heavily utilize venture debt.

name: Regulatory Changes (Financial)
description: New or proposed regulations affecting lending practices, capital requirements for financial institutions, or the venture capital industry.

name: Mergers & Acquisitions (Venture-Backed)
description: News about acquisitions of venture-backed companies, which can impact outstanding venture debt or signal market health.

name: Initial Public Offering (IPO) Market Activity
description: Trends in the IPO market, as successful IPOs can lead to debt repayment or refinancing, affecting overall debt capital flows.

name: Geopolitical Events
description: Major global events (e.g., wars, significant trade disputes) that create uncertainty and impact capital markets.

name: Credit Market Conditions
description: General sentiment and liquidity in broader credit markets, which can influence the availability and terms of venture debt.

name: Technology Innovation & Adoption
description: News about breakthrough technologies or widespread adoption of new tech trends that create new venture-backed opportunities.

name: Corporate Debt Issuance (Non-Venture)
description: Activity in the broader corporate bond market, which can compete for investor capital or reflect overall economic health.

name: Default/Bankruptcy Filings
description: News of venture-backed companies defaulting on loans or filing for bankruptcy, impacting lender confidence and risk assessment.

name: Strategic Investments (Non-VC)
description: Significant investments made by established corporations into venture-backed companies, signaling market validation or consolidation.

name: Supply Chain News
description: Disruptions or improvements in critical supply chains that affect the operational viability and growth prospects of many venture-backed businesses.

name: Neutral/Noise
description: News that is relevant to the venture debt market but has no material directional impact on the overall growth rate of capital raised.
